entities.summary: Diego de Almagro II, called El Mozo, was the son of Spanish conquistador Diego de Almagro and Ana Martínez, a native Panamanian woman. He was however raised, at least partly, by Malgarida who was an emancipated African slave in service of Diego de Almagro.
